description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maligathenna, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320290
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property title matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
